subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: Should OpenClaw allow a specifically marked native compaction result to commit during the safety wrapper's bounded post-timeout settlement window?
rationale: The code can narrowly bind acceptance to the wrapper-owned timeout reason, but choosing whether timeout-aborted work may mutate authoritative session state is a product and state-integrity policy decision.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: After restoring or migrating the Pi timeout dependency, accept the exact reason-owned settlement window and require regression proof for late-result rejection and both runtime siblings.

options.title: Keep timeout handling fail-closed
options.body: Retain inner chunk partial-summary recovery and timeout guidance, but remove the AgentSession path that commits results after timeout cancellation.

options.title: Pause for broader live proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a slow-provider or full gateway run demonstrates recovery and session-state integrity under realistic timing.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: After restoring or migrating the Pi timeout dependency, accept the exact reason-owned settlement window and require regression proof for late-result rejection and both runtime siblings.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to vincentkoc and recent compaction-runtime history makes him the clearest available owner for the timeout/session-state policy.
